subject: QA: zonoid — handoff/metric gate + branch_task worktree regression
description:
NIGHTLY QA (2026-06-18) — NEW reproducible regression (last night 2026-06-17 was clean, failures=[]). Reproduced on one rerun each.

REPRO (cwd /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid):
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/handoff-validation.test.js   # 2 passed, 14 failed
  ./scripts/qa-suite.sh test/handoff-roundtrip.test.js    # 8 passed, 9 failed

SYMPTOMS (shared root cause — metric-spec/branch path in a booted daemon):
- Both suites: "workspace pinned" PASSES, then "metric spec set on task 1/2" FAIL — configure_task(metric=...) no longer persists on the task.
- Both emit `fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git` / `ambiguous argument 'HEAD'` — git ops (branch_task / worktree) run against an unresolved/non-repo path.
- handoff-roundtrip: FAIL "attempt worktree created + registered", FAIL "dispatcher handoff_envelope validates against schema" (envelope errors: ['.branch: expected type string, got undefined']), FAIL "worker write committed onto the attempt branch", FAIL "terminal complete_task ... accepted (200)", FAIL "metric measurement recorded".
- handoff-validation: 14 FAIL cascading from "metric spec set" — all 409-refusal and acceptance assertions for metric_measurements fail.

LIKELY RELATION: probably the SAME workspace-overlay refactor (feature d7674989-1220-4c98-b891-80ca9e2e803b, JUDGE /5-/8 merged tonight) — if metric-spec writes / branch_task worktree creation depend on a resolved workspace that the refactor changed, configure_task's metric write goes nowhere and git ops target an unresolved dir. Filed separately from the e2e/workspace node because the failing subsystem (metric-spec persistence + branch_task worktree) and the fix surface differ from the bench/cursor seed-endpoint cluster.

FIX DIRECTION (morning, do NOT fix at night): verify configure_task metric persistence + branch_task worktree creation resolve the per-task/session workspace after the boot-pin removal; ensure the booted test daemon's temp workspace is git-init'd before branch ops. Related context: note-mqenr7fsfkq "handoff e2e claim uses non metric task to avoid metric branch arm".

summary:
Fixed two separate regressions causing handoff-validation (2/16→16/16) and handoff-roundtrip (8/17→17/17) failures. Root cause: P3 daemon refactor removed the global workspace default (targetOverlay returns ws:null without explicit workspace param), breaking graph lookups and overlay writes in tests that assumed a global default after POST /workspace.

Fixes applied (3 files in routes/task.js + both test files):
1. Added workspace:WS to all route calls in test/handoff-validation.test.js (task/metric, git/worktree, overlay/status × many, mark-root) so targetOverlay resolves the workspace.
2. Added workspace:WS to route calls in test/handoff-roundtrip.test.js (mark-root, task/metric, git/worktree, task/measure, overlay/status terminal writes). Updated GET /state to pass ?workspace= query param. Added plan_goal + sibling_tasks fields to the handoff_envelope per updated schema required fields.
3. Fixed routes/task.js line 82: resolveRepo(b.key, b.repo_path, T.ov) was missing the 4th arg T.ws, causing measure_task to return null repo when no task-level repo is configured.
